highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update.
highlights_body: Review the documented HarfBuzzSharp enum compatibility changes before upgrading code that uses combining-class or aggregate glyph flag members.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed
breaking.body: The misspelled CCC133 member is now CCC132, retaining the numeric value 132. Update source references to use CCC132.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined was removed
breaking.body: The aggregate Defined mask is no longer exposed because it is not an independent option. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154 for preview consumers.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opens the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update and its documented compatibility changes.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: The preview also includes documented compatibility changes for Unicode combining-class and aggregate glyph flag members.
